Arguments\n886\t    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n887\t    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n888\t    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n889\t    ///\n890\t    /// # Returns\n891\t    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n892\t    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n893\t        &self,\n894\t        root_id: &str,\n895\t        direction: &str,\n896\t        max_depth: usize,\n897\t    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n898\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n899\t\n900\t        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n901\t        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n902\t            \"up\" => {\n903\t                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n904\t                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n905\t                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n906\t                (\n907\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n908\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n909\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n910\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n911\t                )\n912\t            }\n913\t            _ => {\n914\t                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n915\t                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n916\t                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n917\t                (\n918\t                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n919\t                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n920\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n921\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n922\t                )\n923\t            }\n924\t        };\n925\t\n926\t        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n927\t            String::new()\n928\t        } else {\n929\t            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n930\t        };\n931\t\n932\t        let sql = format!(\n933\t            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n934\t                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n935\t                SELECT\n936\t                    {id_col} as id,\n937\t                    i.title,\n938\t                    i.status,\n939\t                    i.priority,\n940\t                    0 as depth,\n941\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n942\t                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n943\t                FROM dependencies d\n944\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n945\t                WHERE {anchor_join}\n946\t\n947\t                UNION ALL\n948\t\n949\t                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n950\t                SELECT\n951\t                    {id_col} as dep_type,\n957\t                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n958\t                FROM dependencies d\n959\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n960\t      let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n971\t        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n972\t        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n973\t            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n974\t            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n975\t            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n976\t            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n977\t\n978\t            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n979\t                id: row.get(0)?,\n980\t                title: row.get(1)?,\n981\t                status: row.get(2)?,\n982\t format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n987\t                } else {\n988\t                    path\n989\t                },\n990\t            });\n991\t        }\n992\t        Ok(nodes)\n993\t    }\n994\t\n995\t    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n996\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n997\t        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n998\t    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n1340\t    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n1341\t    ///\n1342\t    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n1343\t    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n1344\t    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n1345\t    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n1346\t    ///\n1347\t    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n1348\t    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n1349\t    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n1350\t    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n1351\t        &self,\n1352\t        model: Option<&str>,\n1353\t        harness: Option<&str>,\n1354\t    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n1355\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1356\t\n1357\t        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n1358\t            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n1359\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1360\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n1361\t                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n1362\t                        i.priority,\n1363\t                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n1364\t                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n1365\t                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n1366\t                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n1367\t                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n1368\t                 FROM issues i\n1369\t                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1370\t                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n1371\t                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n1372\t                     AND vs.model = ?1\n1373\t                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n1374\t                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n1375\t                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n1376\t                   AND i.pinned = 0\n1377\t                   AND i.is_template = 0\n1378\t                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n1379\t                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n1380\t                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n1381\t                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n1382\t                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n1383\t                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1384\t                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n1385\t                   )\n1386\t                 GROUP BY i.id\n1387\t                 ORDER BY\n1388\t                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n1389\t                     downstream_impact DESC,\n1390\t                     critical_float ASC,\n1391\t                     i.priority ASC,\n1392\t                     i.created_at ASC\n1393\t                 LIMIT 1\",\n1394\t            )?;\n1395\t\n1396\t            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n1397\t            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n1398\t                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n1399\t                    row.get(0)?,\n1400\t                    row.get(1)?,\n1401\t                    row.get(2)?,\n1402\t                    row.get(3)?,\n1403\t                    row.get(4)?,\n1404\t                    row.get(5)?,\n1405\t                )))\n1406\t            } else {\n1407\t                Ok(None)\n1408\t            }\n1409\t        } else {\n1410\t            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n1411\t            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n1412\t                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n1413\t                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n1414\t                        i.priority,\n1415\t                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n1416\t                 FROM issues i\n1417\t                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1418\t                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n1419\t                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n1420\t                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n1421\t                   AND i.pinned = 0\n1422\t                   AND i.is_template = 0\n1423\t                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n1424\t                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n1425\t                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n1426\t                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n1427\t                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n1428\t                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n1429\t                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n1430\t                   )\n1431\t                 GROUP BY i.id\n1432\t                 ORDER BY\n1433\t                     downstream_impact DESC,\n1434\t                     critical_float ASC,\n1435\t                     i.priority ASC,\n1436\t                     i.created_at ASC\n1437\t                 LIMIT 1\",\n1438\t            )?;\n1439\t\n1440\t            let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n1441\t            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n1442\t                let downstream_impact: i64 = row.get(0)?;\n1443\t                let critical_float: i64 = row.get(1)?;\n1444\t                let priority: i32 = row.get(2)?;\n1445\t                let created_at_ts: i64 = row.get(3)?;\n1446\t\n1447\t                // Compute combined_score for    issue.acceptance_criteria.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    issue.notes.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    &issue.status.to_string(),\n issue.defer_until.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()), &issue.external_ref, &issue.source_system,\n                    issue.source_repo.as_deref().unwrap_or(\".\"),\n                    issue.deleted_at.map(|d|                    if issue.is_template { 1 } else { 0 },\n                    &issue.id,\n                ],\n            )?;\n\n            // Re-insert labels, dependencies, and comments\n            for label in &issue.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"INSERT INTO labels (issue_id, label) VALUES (?1, ?2)\", params![&issue.id, label])?;\n            }\n            for dep in VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7)\",\n                    params![\n                        &dep.issue_id, &dep.depends_on_id, &dep.dep_type.to_string(),\n )?;\n            }\n            for comment in &issue.comments {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO comments (id, issue_id, author, text, created_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3,          ],\n                )?;\n            }\n\n            // Invalidate critical path cache after updating from JSON (may change deps/status)\n            invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n            compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn close_issue(&self, id: &str, reason: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'closed', ?2, NULL, ?3, ?4)\",\n                params![id, actor, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            // Update worker session with close time and duration for velocity tracking\n            crate::velocity::update_session_on_close(tx, id, now)?;\n            // Invalidate critical path cache: closing a bead can unblock dependents\n            invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n            compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn mark_dirty(&self, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        let conn =    match existing {\n                    None => {\n                        Self::create_issue_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                    }\n                Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            })\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_to_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path, dirty_only: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n        if dirty_only {\n            let result = export_jsonl_dirty(\n       let status_str: String = row.get(7)?;\n        let type_str: String = row.get(9)?;\n        let parse_opt_dt = |idx: usize| -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {\n            let s: Option<String>   Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependencies(&self, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        self.load_dependencies(issue_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Get dependency tree rooted at an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n                path: if is_cycle {\n                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n                } else {\n                    path\n                },\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(nodes)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    pub       events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    pub fn list_events_filtered(\n        &self,\n        issue_id: Option<&str>,\n        since: Option<&DateTime<Utc>>,\n        actor: Option<&str>,\n        event_type: Option<&EventType>,\n        limit: Option<usize>,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, comment, created_at\n             FROM events WHERE 1=1\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n\n        if let Some(id) = issue_id {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND issue_id = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(dt) = since {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND created_at >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(dt.to_rfc3339()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = actor {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND actor = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(a.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(et) = event_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND event_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(et.as_str().to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY created_at ASC\");\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", l));\n        }\n\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_event(row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Event> {\n        let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n        Ok(Event {\n            id: row.get(0)?,\n            issue_id: row.get(1)?,\n            event_type:       assignee: Option<&str>,\n        labels: &[String],\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n        limit: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i))\n                .collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR   sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    ///\n    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n        &self,\n        model: Option<&str>,\n        harness: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n                     AND vs.model = ?1\n                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    row.get(0)?,\n                    row.get(1)?,\n                    row.get(2)?,\n                    row.get(3)?,\n                    row.get(4)?,\n                    row.get(5)?,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                let downstream_impact: i64 = row.get(0)?;\n                let critical_float: i64 = row.get(1)?;\n                let priority: i32 = row.get(2)?;\n                let created_at_ts: i64 = row.get(3)?;\n\n                // Compute combined_score for consistency\n                let combined_score = downstream_impact as f64 * 3.0\n                    + (4 - priority) as f64 * 2.0\n                    + 1000.0 / (critical_float as f64 + 1.0);\n\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    downstream_impact,\n                    critical_float,\n                    priority,\n                    created_at_ts,\n                    None, // No expected_seconds without velocity data\n                    combined_score,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a worker session for tracking metadata.\n    ///\n    /// Stores worker metadata (model, harness, version) for each storage.create_issue(&issue)?;\n\n    println!(\"{}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage =           // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n      println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build       find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for                   candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        path.display()\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        } else if format == \"json\" {\n            println!(\"{{}}\");\n        } else {\n            println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n        }\n    } else if any {\n        // Claim from any {\n            workspace_paths.to_vec()\n        };\n\n        let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            claim(tx, assignee, claim_ttl, Utc::now(), Some(&worker_metadata))\n        })?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n                        \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                    find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n                } else {\n                    workspace_paths.to_vec()\n                };\n\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let          \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle =       issues.push(\"JSONL file contains invalid lines\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Check consistency with content_hash comparison\n    if db_ok && jsonl_ok {\n        let drift = Atomic temp+rename.\n\n```rust\nfn export_jsonl(jsonl_path: &Path, storage: &Storage) -> Result<ExportResult> {\n    let issues = storage.list_all_issues()?;  // sorted by ID\n    let temp_path = jsonl_path.with_extension(\"jsonl.tmp\");\n    let mut writer = BufWriter::new(File::create_new(&temp_path)?);\n    for issue in &issues {\n        serde_json::to_writer(&mut writer, issue)?;\n        writer.write_all(b\"\\n\")?;\n    }\n    writer.flush()?;\n    drop(writer);\n    fs::rename(&temp_path, jsonl_path)?;\n    Ok(ExportResult { count: issues.len() })\n}\n```\n\nFunctions:\n- `export_jsonl(path, storage)` — dump all beads from SQLite to JSONL (atomic)\n- `export_jsonl_dirty(path, storage)` — export only dirty beads (incremental, faster for large workspaces)\n\n### 1.4 Config (`src/config.rs`)\n\nParse `.beads/config.yaml` with the same fields br uses:\n\n```yaml\nissue_prefixes: [bd, fg]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nscoring:\n  priority_weight: 0.4\n  blockers_weight: 0.3\n  age_weight: 0.2\n  labels_weight: 0.1\n  max_age_hours: 20\n  max_blockers: 3\n# bead-forge additions (additive, br ignores these)\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n```\n\nParse `.beads/metadata.json`:\n```json\n{ \"database\": \"beads.db\", \"jsonl_export\": \"issues.jsonl\" }\n```\n\n### 1.5 ID Generation (`src/id.rs`)\n\nPort br's ID scheme: `<prefix>-<hash>` where hash is base36 lowercase. Use the birthday-problem adaptive length (3-8 chars). Read `issue_prefixes` from config (first entry is the default prefix).\n\n```rust\nfn generate_id(prefix: &str, existing_count: usize) -> String {\n    let len = optimal_hash_length(existing_count);\n    let random_bytes = rand::random::<[u8; 16]>();\n    let hash = sha256(&random_bytes);\n    base36_encode(&hash[..len])\n    format!(\"{}-{}\", prefix, hash)\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Phase 2: SQLite Primary Store\n\n### 2.1 Schema Application (`src/storage/schema.rs`)\n\nApply the exact same `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` DDL from br's `SCHEMA_SQL`. Tables:\n\n| Table | Purpose |\n|-------|---------|\n| `issues` | All 35 columns, same types, defaults, CHECK constraints |\n| `dependencies` | (issue_id, depends_on_id) PK, type, metadata, thread_id |\n| `labels` | (issue_id, label) PK |\n| `comments` | AUTOINCREMENT id, issue_id, author, text, created_at |\n| `events` | AUTOINCREMENT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old/new/comment |\n| `config` | key-value |\n| `metadata` | key-value |\n| `dirty_issues` | Track which issues need JSONL export |\n| `export_hashes` | Incremental export tracking |\n| `blocked_issues_cache` | Materialized view of blocked issues |\n| `child_counters` | Hierarchical IDs (bd-abc.1, bd-abc.2) |\n| `recovery_sessions` | Anomaly/recovery audit trail |\n| `anomaly_audit` | Recovery event tracking |\n| `bead_annotations` | bf-only: arbitrary key-value metadata per bead; separate table so br's `rebuild_issues_table()` never touches it |\n\nAll indexes from br must be created identically, including the critical `idx_issues_ready` composite partial index.\n\n### 2.2 Storage Engine (`src/storage/sqlite.rs`)\n\nUse `rusqlite` (not FrankenSQLite) bundled with system SQLite. Apply WAL mode, foreign keys, busy_timeout=30s, cache_size=-8000, synchronous=NORMAL.\n\nAll mutations go through here. JSONL is never touched during normal operation.\n\nFunctions:\n- `open(path: &Path) -> Result<Storage>` — open/create DB, apply schema\n- `get_issue(id: &str) -> Result<Option<Issue>>` — point lookup by ID\n- `list_issues(filter: IssueFilter) -> Result<Vec<Issue>>` — filtered query with WHERE clauses\n- `list_all_issues() -> Result<Vec<Issue>>` — full table scan sorted by ID (for JSONL export)\n- `create_issue(issue: &Issue) -> Result<()>` — INSERT\n- `update_issue(id: &str, changes: IssueChanges) -> Result<()>` — UPDATE + mark dirty\n- `close_issue(id: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<()>` — status transition + mark dirty\n- `with_write_transaction(f) -> Result<T>` — execute closure in a write transaction\n- `with_immediate_transaction(f) -> Result<T>` — `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` with retry (see §2.5) — acquires write lock before any reads (used by claim)\n- `rebuild_blocked_cache() -> Result<()>` — recalculate blocked issues materialized view\n\n### 2.3 Sync Protocol (`src/sync.rs`)\n\nPort br's sync semantics:\n\n**Flush (SQLite → JSONL, for git)**:\n1. Call `export_jsonl_dirty` — query dirty bead IDs, export full current state of each from SQLite\n2. Atomic temp+rename over `issues.jsonl`\n3. Clear `dirty_issues`, update `export_hashes`\n\nFor `bf sync` (full flush): call `export_jsonl` — dump all beads sorted by ID, unconditionally.\n\n**Import (JSONL → SQLite, from git pull)**:\n1. Stream `issues.jsonl` line by line\n2. Compare each with SQLite state using `content_hash`\n3. INSERT new, UPDATE changed, SKIP unchanged\n4. Handle collisions (same ID, different content) with deterministic resolution\n\n### 2.5 Concurrent Write Safety (`src/storage/sqlite.rs`)\n\nSQLite WAL mode serializes concurrent writers through a single write lock — they queue, not corrupt. `SQLITE_BUSY` is returned when a writer cannot acquire the lock within `busy_timeout`. With claim latency of ~1-2ms and a 20-worker fleet, the entire queue clears in ~20-40ms, so `SQLITE_BUSY` should never occur in normal operation.
